mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", product_code AS "productCode", order_qty AS "orderQty", actual_qty AS "actualQty", lot_no AS "lotNo" FROM production_schedule WHERE schedule_date = #{date} ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT id AS "id", schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", product_code AS "productCode", order_qty AS "orderQty", actual_qty AS "actualQty" FROM production_schedule WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT code FROM products WHERE name = #{displayName} OR (spec IS NOT NULL AND spec != '' AND (name || '(' || spec || ')' = #{displayName} OR name || ' (' || spec || ')' = #{displayName})) ORDER BY code LIMIT 1
